products_commission_valid.name: products_commission_valid
products_commission_valid.value: ("products"."commission_type" = 'FIXED_PER_SALE' AND "products"."commission_fixed_paise" IS NOT NULL AND "products"."commission_fixed_paise" > 0) OR ("products"."commission_type" = 'PERCENTAGE' AND "products"."commission_percent" IS NOT NULL AND "products"."commission_percent" >= 1 AND "products"."commission_percent" <= 90)
